name: Tonghua New Infrastructure '761' big data-center-related program
developer: Tonghua Municipal People's Government / local implementing entities
notes: Municipal implementation plan identifies big data centers, AI and industrial internet as part of seven new-infrastructure categories and calls for project planning; no cabinet count or dedicated facility name found.

name: Tonghua Tourism Service Center / tourism big data center
developer: Tonghua tourism project authorities / local contractors
notes: Reported as part of central-city tourism projects with a tourism big data center and 8,670 sqm site; sectoral big-data facility rather than confirmed colocation or hyperscale IDC.

name: Northeast Asia Big Data Industry Center
notes: People's Daily Jilin reported Yanbian planned 15 intelligent information-network projects totaling RMB 4.57 billion, including this big data industry center.

name: Tencent Cloud Global Big Data Center Northeast Node
notes: Named in Yanbian's 2020 new-infrastructure project pipeline as a Tencent Cloud global big data center northeast node; follow-on construction status not confirmed in public sources found.

name: Yanji Cross-border E-commerce Big Data Center
developer: Yanji Cross-border E-commerce Comprehensive Pilot Zone / local authorities
notes: State/commerce policy text calls for establishing a cross-border e-commerce big data center using big data and cloud computing; exact facility scale not disclosed.

name: Montnets Cloud Data Center (Anshan Base)
developer: Montnets / Anshan Yunshu Technology Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Company materials report an operational national A-class, three-carrier data center with 1,174 standard 4.5 kW cabinets, 21,800 sqm building area and PUE <=1.4; capacity_mw inferred from cabinet rating.

name: Ansteel Group Data Center / Ansteel big data center
developer: Ansteel Group / Angang Digital Technology affiliates
notes: SASAC and Industrial Internet Alliance sources describe Ansteel's Anshan-core data and network center supporting group systems; enterprise data center, not public colocation.

name: Commercial Vehicle Safety Monitoring and Intelligent Risk Control Northeast Data Center
notes: Provincial government project-construction report says Anshan secured signing of this northeast regional data center project; no construction update or technical scale found.

name: China Mobile Benxi Shiqiaozi IDC Data Center
notes: Liaoning media reports the Benxi Mobile Shiqiaozi IDC carries Benxi medical insurance cloud, Xinchuang cloud and medical imaging cloud workloads with 24/7 hosting service.

name: Benxi all-for-one tourism big data center project
notes: Benxi 14th Five-Year Plan project list includes a citywide tourism big data center; sectoral data platform/facility, not confirmed IDC colocation.

name: Tsinghua Unigroup cloud integrated big data center project
notes: Chaoyang service-sector plan lists a cloud-node project with more than 1,000 cabinets plus big-data and industrial-internet platforms; follow-on delivery status not found.

name: Chaoyang County Distributed Storage Data Center
notes: Same Chaoyang plan lists a distributed storage data center with 100-200 new storage cabinets and supporting facilities.

name: Chaoyang Smart Agriculture Big Data Center
notes: Digital Chaoyang plan calls for building a smart-agriculture big data center and agricultural data system; sectoral platform, not a large IDC facility.

name: China Mobile (Dalian) Data Center I and II Parks
notes: Reports describe existing Ganjingzi park with 1,000+ cabinets and Pulandian II park planned for about 30,000 racks after all phases; Pulandian facility supports AI-computing cooperation.

name: Dalian Fashion and Industrial Design AI Large Model Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Dalian Mobile, Pulandian District, Shanghai Shejie Technology Group, Hengwei Technology
notes: Strategic agreement signed for Liaoning's first intelligent-computing-center project; it uses China Mobile's Pulandian national super-large data center infrastructure, racks, network export and power.

name: Towngas Telecom Dalian 1 Data Centre
notes: Company page identifies Dalian 1 as Dalian's first carrier-neutral multi-line data center room; detailed MW/cabinet scale not disclosed on source page.

name: China Unicom Dalian Smart City Data Industry Base
notes: C114 reported a strategic framework for China Unicom to invest about RMB 1 billion in a Dalian High-Tech Zone data-industry base; later implementation status not confirmed.

name: Dandong Digital Government Big Data Center and Command Center
developer: Dandong Business Environment Construction Bureau / Dandong Smart City Operation Co., Ltd. / Neusoft
notes: Procurement coverage reports a RMB 55.69 million tender and RMB 55.6 million winning bid for Dandong's digital-government big data center and command center; government IT center rather than hyperscale IDC.

name: Fushun Cloud Data Computing Center project
developer: Wanghua District Government / Weifeng (Liaoning) Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Wanghua District government reported signing a cooperation framework agreement for the cloud data computing center project; no public capacity or construction completion found.

name: Digital Liaoning - Unicom Empowered Computing Power Center
developer: China Unicom Liaoning / Shenfu Reform and Innovation Demonstration Zone
notes: Provincial government says the RMB 1.4 billion project started in Shenfu Demonstration Zone and will build Liaoning Unicom intelligent-computing and AI centers; included under Fushun-area coverage because Shenfu spans the Shenyang-Fushun corridor.

name: Fuxin Energy Big Data Center
developer: State Grid Fuxin Power Supply Company / Northeast Energy Big Data Center
notes: Liaoning government reported the province's first prefecture-level energy big data center was unveiled on 2022-06-15; energy-sector data platform, not public colocation.

name: China Unicom Fuxin Green-Power Intelligent Computing Data Center
developer: China Unicom Fuxin / Fuxin local authorities
notes: Fuxin government response says the Unicom Fuxin green-power intelligent-computing data center project entered provincial leadership/project and 2026 data-infrastructure task pipelines; no MW disclosed.

name: Yunzhen Liaoning Fuxin AI Green Energy Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Fuxin government response lists the Yunzhen Liaoning Fuxin AI green-energy intelligent-computing center in the 2026 provincial data-infrastructure priority task list; scale not disclosed.

name: China Mobile (Liaoning Huludao) Data Center
notes: Energy/news and public procurement sources identify a two-phase national A-class data center in Huludao High-Tech Industrial Development Zone, planned investment RMB 129.7 million and target phase-one operation by end-October 2024.
